claims.text:
Windows 的安全设置有点像家里的电箱：平时没人想看，真出问题又希望它有记录。
当前版本：1.3.1。
这个小工具从 CMD/BAT 进去，用 C# 做检查、预览、备份和恢复。它不负责把电脑变成“绝对安全”，只负责把常见的几件事做得清楚一点。
- 只读审计：防火墙、Defender、UAC、SMBv1、Guest、RDP/NLA、AutoRun、更新服务和待重启状态；
- 生成 Markdown 和 JSON 报告；
- 预览一套保守基线，确认以后才应用；
- 应用前保存清单、SHA-256 和防火墙策略；
- 在同一台电脑上校验后恢复备份；
- 只读列出本机备份目录，并显示清单和 SHA-256 状态；
- Defender 快速扫描、DISM/SFC 只读检查、TCP 监听端口查看；
- 本机兼容性诊断：平台、.NET Framework、WMI 和原生命令能力，支持 JSON 输出；
- 只查询 GitHub Release 版本，不下载脚本，更不会下载完就“相信它”。
- 入站端口、RDP 和管理员账户由用户明确决定，工具不会代为开放或创建；
- 系统重启与 DISM/SFC 修复由用户决定，工具只执行检查和验证；
- 审计结果、用户名、IP 和其他本机数据只保存在本地，不上传；
- 组织策略、MDM 和安全产品保留对系统设置的控制权；
- 静态检查结果按验证范围标注，不替代所有 Windows 版本的实机验证。
如果电脑由公司策略管理，本地设置可能在策略刷新后恢复；请以组织策略和后续审计结果为准。
支持 Windows 10/11 和 Windows Server 2019/2022/2025。运行已编译版本只需要 .NET Framework 4.8；从源码构建需要 .NET 6 SDK 或更高版本。
不需要安装 SDK 时，可以从 v1.3.1 Release 下载 windows-secure-toolkit-v1.3.1-win-x64.zip，解压后进入目录。
从源码运行时，在项目目录打开 CMD：
build.cmd
win_secure.cmd self-test
self-test 只检查程序和清单处理，不修改系统设置。
第一次使用先完成只读检查。下面的命令不会应用安全基线：
win_secure.cmd doctor
win_secure.cmd audit
win_secure.cmd plan
doctor 检查系统兼容性，audit 生成 Markdown 和 JSON 报告，plan 显示将要处理的项目和可能的影响。
阅读计划并确认影响范围后，以管理员身份打开 CMD，再运行：
win_secure.cmd apply
应用前会先创建备份并再次请求确认。程序不会自动开放入站端口、启用 RDP 或创建管理员账户。
先查看备份目录和清单状态：
win_secure.cmd backups
恢复操作需要管理员权限，并会校验备份清单、计算机名称和 SHA-256：
win_secure.cmd restore "C:\ProgramData\WindowsSecureToolkit\Backups\20260818-120000"
win_secure.bat 是兼容入口，功能和 .cmd 相同。
- src/WinSecure.cs ：核心实现；
- src/WindowsSecureToolkit.csproj ：.NET Framework 4.8 项目文件；
- build.cmd ：构建核心程序；
- win_secure.cmd /win_secure.bat ：用户入口；
- scripts/Test-Repository.cmd ：构建、入口和报告烟雾测试；
- docs/THREAT_MODEL.md ：边界和威胁模型。
- docs/WINDOWS_VALIDATION.md ：诊断命令与 Windows 验证矩阵。
本机 Windows 11 专业工作站版 build 26200 已验证：C# 构建、CMD/BAT 启动、版本、自检、审计、计划、报告生成、端口查看和 Release 检查。公开 GitHub Actions 也会在 Windows runner 上构建并运行烟雾测试。
doctor 是只读能力探测，不会因为缺少可选组件就修改系统；doctor --json 输出带 SchemaVersion 的机器可读结果，适合在收集日志前先确认环境。不同 Windows 版本、组织策略和第三方防护软件可能使某些项目显示为 Unavailable，这代表需要人工复核，不代表工具已经替你修复。
实际修改系统的 Apply/Restore 流程没有在维护者机器上执行，因此发布说明不会把它写成已经覆盖所有环境。请先看计划并保留备份。
- 普通问题请使用 Issues；
- 可能暴露系统数据的问题请按照 SECURITY.md 私下报告；
- 提交代码前请阅读 CONTRIBUTING.md。
当前维护者：@KBT096。
本项目自身代码遵循 MIT License 协议发布。构建目标使用 .NET Framework 4.8；运行时调用 netsh、dism、sfc、netstat、WMI 和 Microsoft Defender 等 Windows 系统组件，相关组件的授权和使用条件以 Microsoft Windows 许可条款为准。CI 使用 GitHub Actions 与固定提交的 actions/checkout，仅用于仓库验证，不随工具运行。本仓库不捆绑 YABS、NextTrace 或其他 VPS 探针组件。
本项目采用 MIT License。外部诊断工具仍分别受其上游许可证约束。

bottom_line: Security analysts can deploy ShadowBroker to unify multi-domain global OSINT telemetry and AI agent workflows into a single self-hosted map interface.

title: duty1g/x64dbg-mcp-server — x64dbg-MCP Server is a native MCP (Model Context Protocol) plugin for x64dbg that exposes the debugger's full
one_liner: x64dbg-MCP Server exposes full x64dbg debugger controls to AI assistants via a native, zero-dependency Model Context Protocol plugin.
summary: The x64dbg-MCP Server is a native Model Context Protocol plugin for the x64dbg debugger, written in Zig with zero dependencies to expose full debugging capabilities over HTTP. It offers 71 MCP tools covering disassembly, breakpoints, memory reading, and register dumping, alongside 22 event callbacks for comprehensive trace and execution control. The single binary supports cross-compilation for both 32-bit and 64-bit architectures from any host operating system. To secure sensitive debugging operations, it enforces mandatory Bearer token authentication generated on first run.
bottom_line: Reverse engineers can programmatically control x64dbg via AI assistants using the native x64dbg-MCP Server plugin.

title: Connecting the Dots: Securing the Overlooked Corners of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) Supply Chain
one_liner: The ChainDrop npm worm highlights how attackers poison CI/CD pipelines and developer environments to harvest cloud secrets and propagate malware.
summary: Recent threat intelligence from Unit 42 highlights a massive shift in supply-chain attacks toward poisoning the software development lifecycle (SDLC) rather than targeting finished applications. title: Named Pipes Under Attack: Securing Windows Interprocess Communication
one_liner: Treat Windows named pipes as exposed network interfaces to prevent local privilege escalation attacks across different security contexts.
summary: Windows named pipes, frequently used for interprocess communication between privileged services and user-facing desktop applications, are frequently mismanaged under the unsafe assumption that local communication is implicitly trusted. Because local environments host unrelated processes operating under various security contexts, an exposed named pipe can act as an unauthorized API to privileged functionality if permissions are overly permissive. Developers must implement strict access controls, avoid broad 'Everyone' or 'Authenticated Users' permissions, and ensure authentication, authorization, and impersonation routines are handled securely to prevent privilege escalation.
bottom_line: Assuming Windows named pipes are secure because they are local creates severe privilege escalation risks, requiring strict explicit access controls and input verification.

title: How an Emerging Industrial Protocol Family Could Put OT at Risk
one_liner: Unsecured Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) protocols in industrial automation expose operational technology to physical process manipulation.
summary: Recent research presented at Black Hat USA by Nozomi Networks researchers reveals that unencrypted Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) protocols used in industrial automation can be exploited to manipulate physical operational technology (OT) processes. TSN protocols orchestrate deterministic traffic flow over standard Ethernet to prevent communication collisions in safety-critical manufacturing environments. However, researchers demonstrated that lack of robust security controls allows attackers to tamper with process variables—such as starting or stopping robotic arms—or inject subtle timing drifts into synchronization clocks that cause damaging, delayed failures.

bottom_line: Vulnerabilities in Time-Sensitive Networking protocols allow attackers to remotely manipulate industrial machinery and inject dangerous clock drifts into OT networks.

bottom_line: Local LLM performance is highly sensitive to implementation details like sampler settings and hardware-specific math execution.

title: More than just code review
one_liner: Offers a strategic perspective on the evolving role of code review in the age of AI agents.
summary: Simon Willison argues that the primary skill for using coding agents is effectively instructing them and verifying their changes rather than just line-by-line code review. He suggests that manual code review is often less effective than other validation methods for software changes. The post also references recent articles on Qwen 3.8 27B's performance and a timeline of an accidental OpenAI attack on Hugging Face. The focus is on the shift in developer workflow necessitated by agentic tools.
bottom_line: Productive use of AI agents requires a shift from manual code review to high-level instruction and verification strategies.

claims.text: The key skill for coding agents is instructing and verifying changes rather than just reviewing code.
claims.support_span: The key skill required to make productive use of coding agents is being able to confidently instruct them on how to make changes and then confidently verify that those changes have been applied in the correct way.
